name: quality-atelier
description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace for QA work: one plugin writes structured test case specs from your project docs, the other turns those specs into test code and runs it.

plugins.name: testcase-artisan
plugins.description: Generates and maintains structured test case specifications from project docs. Does not write or run test code.

plugins.name: testrun-forgemaster
plugins.description: Writes and runs test code strictly from test case specs defined by testcase-artisan, then reports results in plain language. Never modifies app code.
